text: Protocol versioning: a too-old client is turned away and sent to the update mechanism (design)

Done: server gate + protocol.py + release guard (T-243), web/Android clients (T-244). release.sh now refuses any release below 3.0.0 while PROTOCOL_VERSION is 3. Old 2.x apps get 426 with an unknown code and rely on their existing update check: the 3.0.0 release notes must say every device is updated together with the server.
